title: The Baker's Mistake
description: A pastry apprentice accidentally doubles the yeast in a morning batch of croissants, creating an unexpectedly flaky breakthrough.
character_reference: a young baker with flour smudged across their forehead and wearing a rolled-up linen chef coat

scenes.narration: The kitchen was silent at four in the morning, save for the rhythmic hum of the proofing cabinet.
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a stainless steel kitchen lit by pale blue pre-dawn light through a high window

scenes.narration: Half asleep, I misread the scale and poured twice the amount of active yeast into the laminated dough.
scenes.visual: Close-up of white flour dusting a wooden countertop next to a spilled measuring spoon

scenes.narration: By sunrise, the dough had ballooned past the rim of the tray, looking like a total disaster.
scenes.visual: Medium close-up of buttery dough bubbling over the edges of a metal baking sheet

scenes.narration: Instead of tossing it out, I rolled it thin, folded the butter layers, and slid it into the hot oven.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a rolling pin flattening golden sheets of butter and pastry dough on marble

scenes.narration: The oven door window fogged up as the pastries rose into towering, golden-brown spirals.
scenes.visual: Close-up peering through a hot oven glass at flaky pastries expanding with caramelized layers

scenes.narration: When pulled apart, they shattered into a million delicate, airy layers that melted instantly.
scenes.visual: Macro shot of hands breaking open a warm, steaming croissant revealing honeycomb interiors

scenes.narration: Sometimes our happiest kitchen accidents teach us more than any recipe book ever could.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a satisfied grin while dusting excess flour away from a golden pastry crust

scenes.narration: If you love sweet breakthroughs, follow along for more stories.
scenes.visual: Warmly lit close-up of fresh pastries resting on a cooling rack dusted with powdered sugar
